allowed.reason: The runtime handle smoke constructs isolated runtime owners before WorkerPool, Window, renderer, or Run startup.
allowed.cap: Two owner allocations when --physics-standalone-smoke is requested.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Keep this validation-only path outside steady gameplay; convert to stack or fixture-owned storage if the smoke grows.

allowed.reason: WinMain creates the DX12 backend and Run composition root before steady gameplay begins.
allowed.cap: One backend and one Run allocation per process launch.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Leave as startup composition-root ownership unless process bootstrap moves to arena-backed lifetime storage.

allowed.reason: The skybox owner is rebuilt during scene/resource initialization, not ordinary gameplay simulation.
allowed.cap: One skybox owner for the active scene/resource set.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: If scene churn remains allocation-sensitive, move these owner objects into preallocated world-resource storage.

allowed.reason: Scene load/reset creates terrain resources from scene data before returning to steady gameplay.
allowed.cap: One terrain owner per scene load/reset path.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Move terrain object lifetime to a reusable scene-load arena if scene churn becomes allocation-sensitive.

allowed.reason: Backend resource factory calls create typed GPU resource owner objects during backend/resource initialization and explicit scene resource rebuilds.
allowed.cap: One owner object per requested shader, mesh, or framebuffer resource.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Route resource owner allocation through a backend resource arena before strict allocation enforcement covers resource rebuilds.

allowed.reason: The global C++ allocation hook needs one raw CRT backing call pair so it can wrap allocations with fixed tracker metadata.
allowed.cap: One backing allocation per intercepted C++ allocation, sized exactly from the caller request plus fixed header/alignment padding.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Keep raw heap calls isolated in this wrapper; future arena work should replace this implementation without adding raw calls elsewhere.

allowed.reason: The allocator implementation owns the single approved replay reserve-bump API; callsites outside this file still require owner metadata and phase checks.
allowed.cap: One function definition for the replay growth policy gate; runtime grants remain bounded per registered owner.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Keep growth approval isolated here and reject any new reserve-bump callsite unless it routes through registered owner wrappers.

allowed.reason: Prediction frames, frame payload pools, private prediction engine storage, and trajectory records share one registered replay growth gate.
allowed.cap: Registered owner replay_prediction_working_set with a 256 MiB hard byte cap; callers pass byte capacities and must reserve under matching replay scopes.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Keep prediction growth behind RequestReplayPredictionReserveGrowth/ReserveReplayPredictionVector or replace the working set with a fixed prediction arena.

allowed.reason: The private prediction engine object is constructed lazily inside the replay reserve owner scope so normal runtime startup and perf-smoke paths do not pay PhysicsWorld reserve memory.
allowed.cap: One PhysicsEngine instance retained by RunReplayPredictionState; its construction and copied store growth are counted under replay_prediction_working_set with the 256 MB hard cap.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Replace with a dedicated replay prediction arena/object factory if runtime allocation policy gains typed owner allocators; do not construct the private engine at startup.

allowed.reason: Presentation and solver sample body vectors grow lazily under active scene size instead of startup game_model_capacity.
allowed.cap: Registered owner replay_recorder_samples, hard cap REPLAY_RECORDER_SAMPLE_RESERVE_HARD_BYTES per retained sample body-vector reserve.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Replace retained body vectors with a flat replay arena/body dictionary when replay memory tuning lands; keep recorder growth behind ReserveReplayRecorderSampleVector until then.

allowed.reason: Solver replay snapshots batch many typed vector payload reserves into one byte-budget approval before copying physics state.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Replace snapshot vectors with an arena-backed snapshot record if replay solver storage is flattened.

allowed.reason: _dupenv_s returns CRT-owned buffers while reading profiler marker environment overrides before WorkerPool, Window, backend, or Run startup.
allowed.cap: At most two environment buffers per process launch.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: If environment parsing grows, route it through a startup-only platform helper that owns the CRT cleanup.

allowed.reason: stb_vorbis_decode_filename returns a decoder-owned PCM buffer that is copied into the startup/scene-load audio cache and then released.
allowed.cap: One decoder buffer per configured contact-audio sample while audio maps are loaded.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: If contact-audio decoding moves onto a gameplay path, route decoded samples through a preallocated audio asset cache.

allowed.reason: The pimpl object hides platform audio headers and is created/destroyed with the service, outside classification and mixing hot paths.
allowed.cap: Exactly one Impl allocation for the ContactAudioService instance.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Replace with inline storage if contact-audio platform headers become acceptable in the public header.

allowed.reason: D3D12 debug message retrieval uses variable message lengths while reporting validation/device diagnostics, not ordinary gameplay work.
allowed.cap: One temporary buffer per debug message, bounded by the D3D12 info queue message length.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Move to a fixed diagnostics scratch buffer if this path is ever enabled during steady gameplay validation.

allowed.reason: Text atlas generation builds CPU image buffers before runtime text rendering consumes backend resources.
allowed.cap: Atlas dimensions selected by the text system; allocations happen during atlas construction only.
allowed.removal_or_wrapper_plan: Move atlas construction through a startup arena if text atlas generation becomes runtime-mutable.
